status: Local SAM 3.1 deployed on the installed vision, mission and web services; package, recorded-video and endurance qualification complete. Live operator flight acceptance is separate.

model.name: Official SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex
model.live_adapter: Pinned native state initializer, detector, tracker and postprocessing; guarded append-only frames and native-selected bounded tracking memories. No indefinite append-frame API is claimed for the unmodified upstream predictor.

package.weights_and_credentials: Read-only mounts; neither is baked into the image.
package.readiness: Systemd Type=notify from the host launcher after compiled warmup, socket creation and one successful HTTP health check.

protocol.scope: Synthetic camera translation, rotation and zoom of recorded native 4K nadir images; not live forward tracking or moving-person acceptance.
protocol.live_prompt_policy: Visible text up to 100 characters and 30 tokenizer tokens. Warmup phrases are coverage fixtures, not a production whitelist.
protocol.timing_scope: Original JPEG preparation, SAM inference, PNG mask encoding, local HTTP transfer and production client source/mask validation. Excludes new camera acquisition, Glimmer, flight control and browser transport.

validation.scope: Ten recorded original forward-camera JPEGs, manually marked visible or absent; one short sighting, not broad recognition accuracy or a live-flight test.

soak.scope: Paced repetition of 20 recorded synthetic-motion frames per drone through persistent HTTP sessions. Age is measured against scheduled replay time, not physical camera capture. Paced throughput is not the saturated-throughput benchmark or proof of recognition accuracy.

browser.scope: Actual React components in Chromium, recorded image assets and simulated video transport; no connection to mission or Unreal.

final_package_vs_earlier_compiled_adapte.scope: Packaged output versus earlier compiled adapter, first 40 frames per lane (20-frame canonical sequence repeated twice). This is a measured comparison, not a numerical equivalence or recognition-accuracy gate. Exact detection equality failed and is retained in final-output-validation.log.

output_agreement.modal_gate: The existing 0.001 confidence and 0.5-pixel Modal gate is unchanged; these local video comparisons do not pass or replace that gate.

object_changes.scope: Prefinal image, synthetic collage with changing counts, a blank gap and return; not recognition-accuracy validation.

earlier_live_acquisition.scope: Stationary, disarmed aircraft; real 4K capture plus local 1080p inference, no flight commands or reviewer requests.
earlier_live_acquisition.capture_optimization: Deferred. Packaged replay throughput does not establish five new live captures per second per drone.

initial_shutdown.journal_read_note: Initial unprivileged journal query had no accessible records; the privileged read above establishes service success.

retained_failures.reason: Initial adapter used a field absent in the pinned multiplex state; corrected against upstream.
Native detector modulo input-ring indexing; corrected with the one-frame current-input ring.
First measured pass was below 20.16 FPS; later mask bounds extraction optimization is separately measured.
More than 16 active objects failed explicitly; capacity was not silently expanded or candidates dropped.
Previously unseen threshold caused compilation; startup now warms threshold variation and verifies stable counters.
Browser fixture navigation/body handling failed; corrected fixture passed in browser-02.
Session runner lacked PYTHONPATH after the successful throughput and forward runs. Corrected session qualification is recorded separately; successful benchmarks were preserved.
Exact detection equality to earlier compiled output failed. Subsequent comparison records actual mask, confidence and box differences; the exact gate was not passed.

limitations: No installed end-to-end rescue flight or live Glimmer escalation/rejection acceptance has run with this SAM image.
The 30-minute soak repeats recorded footage; it does not establish mission-long recognition quality, moving-person reacquisition or high-object-count endurance.
Warmup covers the tested prompts, thresholds and object shapes. Performance for every possible live scene is not established.
Native capacity is 16 active objects per drone; exceeding it is a terminal failure.
The physical deployment GPU still needs its own throughput and memory qualification.
The displayed WebRTC video and inference samples have independent timing. Live boxes are padded guidance; precise masks are restricted to matching evidence images.

Installed throughput varied across passes: 19.23–22.12 FPS after fleet readiness, and 18.69 FPS during fleet startup. The 20.16 FPS target is not a demonstrated per-pass lower bound under all shared-simulator workloads.
source_scope: Source hashes identify the qualified SAM implementation. The integrated change preserves the existing mission-planning and flight-diagnostics work that was included in the full passing test run.
